name: CaseHOLD
description: A legal benchmark of more than 53,000 multiple-choice questions identifying the relevant holding of a cited case, with five candidate holdings per question.
citation: Lucia Zheng, Neel Guha, Brandon R. Anderson, Peter Henderson, and Daniel E. Ho. 2021. When Does Pretraining Help? Assessing Self-Supervised Learning for Law and the CaseHOLD Dataset. In Proceedings of the 18th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL '21). ACM. https://doi.org/10.1145/3462757.3466088

license.notes: The upstream CaseHOLD repository declares Apache-2.0.
